description: The models agents Licium runs for you (your always-on teammate) answer with, on your own account. action list: your connections (provider, status, account, models; never a credential). action start: provider chatgpt starts OpenAI's Sign in with ChatGPT and returns sign_in.url: allow "Use your ChatGPT plan" (Plus or Pro); the browser then lands on an address starting http://127.0.0.1:1455/auth/callback that does not load, and that whole address is the code for action sign_in. Provider claude starts Claude Code's own sign-in in your box on Licium's side and returns sign_in.url (an Anthropic page): sign in there with your Claude Pro or Max account, and the code it shows is the code for action sign_in. Send it within 14 minutes. Provider openai_key or anthropic_key with provider_secret (and optional model) sets your own key, kept sealed. action set_model: connection_id and model. action remove: connection_id (a ChatGPT sign-in is revoked at OpenAI, a Claude box is deleted).

code.description: Action sign_in: for ChatGPT the whole address the browser landed on; for Claude the code Anthropic's page showed.

provider_secret.description: Your OpenAI or Anthropic API key (action start with provider openai_key or anthropic_key).

name: model_connection
title: Connect your own ChatGPT or Claude plan or key
